info.name: CyberSource Merged Spec bankAccountValidation Reports API

params.name: startTime
params.description:
Valid report Start Time in **ISO 8601 format**
Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)

**Example date format:**
  - yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ (e.g. 2018-01-01T00:00:00.000Z)

params.name: endTime
params.description:
Valid report End Time in **ISO 8601 format**
Please refer the following link to know more about ISO 8601 format.[Rfc Date Format](https://xml2rfc.tools.ietf.org/public/rfc/html/rfc3339.html#anchor14)

**Example date format:**
  - yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ (e.g. 2018-01-01T00:00:00.000Z)

params.name: timeQueryType
params.description:
Specify time you would like to search

Valid values:
- reportTimeFrame
- executedTime

params.name: reportMimeType
params.description:
Valid Report Format

Valid values:
- application/xml
- text/csv

params.name: reportFrequency
params.description:
Valid Report Frequency

Valid values:
- DAILY
- WEEKLY
- MONTHLY
- USER_DEFINED
- ADHOC

params.name: reportStatus
params.description:
Valid Report Status

Valid values:
- COMPLETED
- PENDING
- QUEUED
- RUNNING
- ERROR
- NO_DATA

items.docs: Retrieve a list of the available reports to which you are subscribed. This will also give you the reportId value, which you can also use to download a report.

Create a one-time report. You must specify the type of report in reportDefinitionName. For a list of values for reportDefinitionName, see the [Reporting Developer Guide](https://www.cybersource.com/developers/documentation/reporting_and_reconciliation)

info.name: Get Report Based on Report Id

items.docs: Download a report using the reportId value. If you don't already know this value, you can obtain it using the Retrieve available reports call.
